criteria.requirement: Implement statemachine.replay.replay(factory,document,*,verify=True,max_records=10000) returning frozen ReplayResult(machine,results). Fully validate completed JSON journal before calling factory; never import a class name from data. Run each EventCall through completed MachineRunner on the new factory instance and preserve native callback execution. Verify before/after states and values plus passed/error status per index, reject divergence before next event; verify=False returns actual results explicitly. Handle empty journals and expected disallowed events. Do not mutate journal data or claim external callback side effects are rolled back.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
